_comment: The Prayer world: its paths, one file each in paths/, in the order the map offers them. A path names its tier (frontend/src/grow.json lists the tiers) and cuts its steps into groups: a group is one node on the map, `icon` names its picture, and every step sits in exactly one group. A ruling names its `source` (../../sources.json); its `arabic` is that source's own sentence, never paraphrased, and tests/test_grow.py holds every one to its source. A step with no clear sentence in the book carries no ruling.
